## Summary

**Project structure:**
```
TicketClassifier/
├── Controllers/TicketController.cs   # API endpoints
├── Data/tickets.csv                  # Training data
├── Models/
│   ├── TicketData.cs                 # ML.NET input/output models
│   └── TicketRequest.cs              # API request/response DTOs
├── Services/TicketClassifierService.cs # ML pipeline & prediction
├── Program.cs                        # DI registration
└── TicketClassifier.csproj           # ML.NET 4.0.2 dependency
```

**Endpoints:**
- `POST /api/ticket/predict` — Accepts `{subject, description, priority}`, returns predicted category + confidence scores
- `GET /api/ticket/metrics` — Returns model evaluation metrics (macro/micro accuracy, log loss)

**ML Pipeline:** Text featurization (Subject + Description) → concatenate with Priority → normalize → SDCA Maximum Entropy multiclass classifier.

The model trains at startup from `Data/tickets.csv` and dynamically extracts label ordering from the fitted pipeline for accurate confidence score mapping.
